api_layer: Axios HTTP Client with REST query parameters (`frontend/src/lib/api.js`)
filter_flow: User Selection -> URL Query Params -> FastAPI `/recommendations` -> Supabase SQL Query -> Match Score Ranking -> JSON Response -> Client-Side Verification Net

dynamic_verification.hardcoded_status: NO HARDCODED ISSUES. The frontend dynamically renders arrays returned by `fetchRecommendations`.
dynamic_verification.server_side_filtering: Yes. FastAPI applies strict language matching, availability status checks, and difficulty gating before returning candidates.
dynamic_verification.client_side_safety_net: Yes. `IssueFeedPage.jsx` includes a secondary difficulty filter (`matchesDifficulty`) and dynamic search bar (`matchesSearch`).
dynamic_verification.ranking_algorithm: Personalized match score computed in backend (+40 tech stack, +20 domain match, +30 suitability score, +10 maintainer signals).
